specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: The AMS has 4 filament slots, each filament slot has its own motor and gears to actively push the filament forward or wind it back to the spool.
specs.note: Agrees with the store page description ("Each Bambu Lab AMS is composed of 4 filament slots"), which the package does not parse into a row.

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: H2 Series AMS Connection Guide › Cable Connection
specs.quote: Each AMS has two 6-pin ports on the back, allowing you to daisy-chain multiple AMS units.
specs.note: The guide defines "AMS" as the AMS (first generation), AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT together. The same section: "6-pin cables are required to connect AMS to 3D printer for power and communication". The guide also notes the cable supplied with the AMS has a 1.1 mm step height (2.5 mm for AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT); no registry key holds it.

specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: when using AMS, please note that the ambient temperature must be maintained at 10-30 ℃ and the humidity must be less than 85%.
specs.note: The same sentence requires humidity below 85%; no registry key for humidity applies to the ams type (part.humidity is parts-only).

specs.source_title: AMS main functions and workflow introduction | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: AMS feeding system introduction › Filament hub
specs.quote: The odometer is used to determine whether the filament has been sent out of the AMS, and can also be used to calculate the length of the filament sent out.
specs.note: The X1 manual page describes the same part as "one magnetic rotary encoder" in the Filaments Hub.

specs.source_title: AMS main functions and workflow introduction | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: The main functions of AMS › Filament run-out detection and auto-refill function
specs.quote: When you use AMS printing, it still has the filament run-out detection function
specs.note: Each filament slot also has a sensor to detect the filament (X1 manual, "Filament Slot"). Agrees with the store page feature bullet "Filament Runout & Winding Detection".

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab AMS - Automatic Material System: store page
specs.quote: When the filament at the toolhead encounters resistance, it may be that the filament is tangled or the spool is stuck, AMS can detect it immediately and suspend printing
specs.note: Store page prose only, so unverified. The connection guide attributes tangle detection to the filament buffer ("The filament buffer assists with feeding filament from the AMS to the printer by adjusting the feeding speed and detecting filament tangles"), which the store page lists in the box but which X1/P1 setups must otherwise buy separately.

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: A1 Series Connection Guide › Maximum number of connected AMS units
specs.quote: Supports up to 4 AMS units (AMS, AMS 2 Pro, or AMS HT) connected at the same time. You can mix these models in any combination.
specs.test_condition: A1 series: up to 4 AMS units in total (AMS, AMS 2 Pro or AMS HT, any mix), through the A1 series AMS Hub
specs.note: Agrees with the A1 Series variant description ("A1 series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units (including AMS HT, AMS, AMS 2 Pro).").

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: X1/P1 Series Connection Guide › Maximum number of connected AMS units
specs.quote: Maximum number of connected AMS units: The X1/P1 supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro or 4 AMS HT units — 4 units in total.
specs.test_condition: X1/P1 series, through the AMS Hub: 4 units in total (AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT counted together)
specs.note: The guide calls the AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT collectively "AMS", so its cap of 4 units in total covers this unit. The X1 manual's AMS introduction states the first-generation count in words ("The AMS Hub replaces the filament Buffer. It allows the user to connect four AMS units, which in turn can supply 16 different filament spools to the printer."); the X1/P1 variant descriptions say "up to 4 AMS units (including AMS HT, AMS, AMS 2 Pro)". All agree.

notes: Adjudication against the second extraction (184 field disagreements): the two 6-pin ports stay connectivity.interface (as in the other AMS files; not also electrical.connector); compatibility keeps the compat-targets kinds and handles (family / printer); the in-the-box list keeps one row per store line with no derived quantity for the AMS itself; not_published electrical.current stays (searched like the other electrical keys). Taken from the second: status unverified for the P2S, H2S, H2D/H2C and X2D unit counts (store variant prose only; no cached official document states the first-generation count for them), the precise H2D/H2C relation locators (the X2D relation's locator now names the "Accessory Required" bullet its own quote comes from, not the second's "PTFE Tube Connection"), and the guide's own name for the H2 series dedicated adapter. Added from the second after checking the cached pages: printing.multi_color for X1/P1 (intro page), the new-version 6-pin cable relation (connection guide) and 19 material relations from the filament guide's AMS / AMS lite column. Corrected for the quote check: the X1/P1 unit count now quotes the guide's "4 units in total" line (the intro page spells the number).

Second adjudication pass, 2026-10-17 (all 184 disagreements re-read in the cached connection guide, the X1 AMS introduction, the AMS functions page, the filament guide and the corpus store page with its variant notes, What's in the box and AMS Tech Specs; target kinds, labels and handles re-checked in compat-targets.json): no value changed. The kept handles, kinds (P2S and H2D family, H2S, H2C and X2D printer, A2 Series family) and labels ("A1 series AMS Hub"; "4-pin Cable (CAB002-N)", the compat-targets entry "4-pin Cable(CAB002-N)" left ambiguous_target_needs_review) follow compat-targets.json; the AMS item keeps no quantity because the store list gives none; the 19 material relations and the 6-pin cable relation match their cached rows word for word; the AMS Tech Specs table carries no electrical, noise or certification row, so the six not_published keys stand.
